requestId.description:
Unique request identifier in GUID format included in the header, used to trace and correlate API calls across systems.
> **Note:** We strongly recommend including the `requestId` header in every API request. This unique GUID helps trace and correlate API calls across systems, ensuring better observability and troubleshooting.

level3.description:
Level 3 data provides detailed line-item information for each sale item in a transaction, including descriptions, quantities, pricing, and discounts. This level of detail enhances transparency, improves financial reporting and reconciliation, and supports compliance with procurement policies. It also enables more efficient processing for corporate and government transactions, often resulting in lower interchange fees and stronger vendor relationships.

Recommendations for Level 3 Transactions:
- Use a Level 3-enabled card and provide detailed line-item data.
- Ensure a non-zero tax amount is included for Level 2 and Level 3 transactions.

description.description: Description or name of the sale item

unitCost.description: The cost per single unit of the item being purchased.

price.description: Represents the total price of the item sold.

commodityCode.description: Code used to classify the type of goods or services involved in transaction. DPP APIs do not enforce validations for commodity codes. It is recommended to use standardized lists by referring the [link](https://www.mpiprocessing.com/level-3-and-level-2-credit-card-processing-commodity-codes/)

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measuring the item. The API do not enforce validations for units of measure, it is recommended to use standardized lists by referring the [link](https://help.usaepay.info/developer/reference/umcodes/)

freightAmount.description: The cost of shipping or transportation for the item.

dutyAmount.description: The cost of customs duties or import taxes (especially for international purchases).

itemDiscountAmount.description: Discount amount applied on sale item

itemDiscountRate.description: Discount rate of the sale item

taxAmount.description: Tax amount applied on the sale item.

level2.description: Level 2 data enhances transactions by adding contextual fields like customer reference numbers, tax indicators, shipping ZIP codes, and purchase card flags. This additional metadata improves reporting accuracy, simplifies reconciliation, and supports compliance and audit readiness while offering better visibility into spending behavior.

localTaxFlag.description:
Indicator, if local taxes apply.
> Note: On `localTaxFlag` behavior, user can send the acceptable values 1 and 2.
- If `taxAmount = 0.00`, set **`localTaxFlag = 2`**, which indicates it is an tax exempted item.  
- If `taxAmount > 0.00`, set **`localTaxFlag = 1`**.

shippingZip.description: Zip/Postal code of the shipping address

taxAmount.description: Total Tax Amount is the sum of all individual tax amounts applied to each sale item in a transaction. It represents the overall tax charged on the entire purchase.

customData.description: Custom data allows integrators to pass additional, customizable information related to a transaction when it does not fit into any predefined fields. This feature supports sending data as name–value pairs (e.g., Invoice Number and its corresponding value).

name.description: Custom Data field name or key

productData.description: Product data contains key details about the products or services involved in a fleet transaction. This information supports accurate billing, expense tracking, and reporting. However, product data fields do not enforce validations by themselves. Therefore, always refer to the product master data before initiating any transaction to ensure accuracy and consistency.

productCode.description: Unique code used to identify the product.

serviceCode.description: Code that represents the service associated with the product.

unitMeasurement.description: The unit in which the product is measured.

unitQuantity.description: The number of smaller units contained within the product.

unitPrice.description: The price per single unit of the product.

price.description: The total value of the single product.

CustomerData.description: Customer data includes critical details such as odometer readings, sequence numbers, and driver license information. Capturing this data during fleet transactions ensures accuracy and accountability. It also provides valuable context on vehicle usage and driver activity, supporting improved tracking, reporting, and regulatory compliance.

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence number of the fleet card transaction

odometer.description: Odometer reading of the vehicle captured during transaction

driversLicenseNumber.description: Driving Licence number of the driver captured during transaction

CustomerDataArray.description: Customer data includes critical details such as odometer readings, sequence numbers, and driver license information. Capturing this data during fleet transactions ensures accuracy and accountability. It also provides valuable context on vehicle usage and driver activity, supporting improved tracking, reporting, and regulatory compliance.

customerCode.description:
Please ensure that the correct value is provided in this field based on the intended identifier type.
- **DS** - Indicates `sequenceNumber`
- **04** - Indicates `odometer`
- **05** - Indicates `driversLicenseNumber`

customerValue.description:
Ensure the correct value is passed in this field based on the identifier type.
- Send exactly 5 digts for `sequenceNumber(DS)`
- Send 9 digits(max) for `odometer(04)`
- Send 15 digits(max) for `driversLicenseNumber(05)`

amount.description: Object to hold transaction amount details such as the monetary value and the currency (e.g., USD, CAD). It specifies the financial amount involved in the transaction.

subscription.description: Object to hold the subscription details such as subscription start and end dates, billing frequency (e.g., Monthly, Annually), and optional fields such as active status, payment day of the week, and payment month. It defines the schedule and duration for recurring charges.

startDate.description: Specifies the starting date from which recurring billing begins. The startDate must either match the subscription transaction date or be set to a future date.

endDate.description: Defines the termination date of the subscription period.

frequency.description: Indicates how often billing occurs e.g., Monthly, Quarterly, or Annually

active.description: Boolean flag to reflect whether the subscription is currently active or not

paymentDay.description: Specifies the designated day of the week (e.g., Sunday) when payment is scheduled to process; useful for weekly plans.

paymentMonth.description: Defines the month (1 to 12) when payment is intended to occur, relevant for annual billing cycles.

custom.description: Object to hold the custom subscription details.

interval.description: Specifies the frequency of the billing cycle based on the defined interval type.

intervalType.description: Defines the unit of time used for the billing interval (for example, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly).

duration.description:
Specifies how long the subscription will continue.
- **FIXED_PAYMENTS:** Runs for a limited number of payments.
- **UNTIL_END_DATE:** The subscription continues indefinitely until end date.
- **UNTIL_CANCELLED:** The subscription continues indefinitely until manually cancelled.

numberOfPayments.description: Specifies the total number of billing cycles for the subscription. This field is required when duration is set to FIXED and is ignored when duration is UNTIL_CANCELLED.

alternateFee.description: Object to hold additional fee details passed by the integrator, such as the fee amount, percentage, fee type (e.g., Surcharge), and optional flags indicating whether the fee is waived or added to the total transaction amount.

feePercent.description: Percentage of surcharge to be charged

amount.description: Amount of surcharge calculated based on

waived.description: Flag to tell if the fee is to be waived or not

addedToTotalAmount.description: Flag to tell if the fee is to be added to the total amount

ProcessingFee.description: Object to hold additional fee details passed by the integrator, such as the fee amount, percentage, fee type (e.g., Processing Fee).

PartnerFee.description: Object to hold additional fee details passed by the integrator, such as the fee percentage, fee type (e.g., Partner Fee).

orderData.description: Object to hold order details such as a unique order ID, a flag indicating whether the order ID should be automatically generated, and whether the order ID is required to be unique. It supports custom or system-generated order identification.

autoGenerateOrderId.description: Flag to tell if Order Id is to be automatically generated

orderIdIsUnique.description: Flag to tell if Order Id is unique

fee.description: Object to hold applied fee details such as the fee amount and the authorizer’s response code for the fee transaction. It captures information related to fee authorization and processing.

feeAuthResponse.description: Authorizer's response code for fee payment

accountResponseData.description: Object to hold account verification responses such as AVS (Address Verification Service) and CVV check results. These fields indicate the outcome of address and card security code validations, typically returned by the payment processor.

Disbursement.description: Request data type details for disbursement the payment

amount.description: A portion of the total amount needs to be disbursed to the specified disbursementId.

description.description: Description of disbursement in which amount is to be credited

accountNumberLastFour.description: Disbursement account number with last four digits
